project_type: Single-file vanilla JS PWA (Forma fitness app), bilingual UI with translation dict
test_command: for f in tools/*.test.mjs; do node $f; done
verification_instructions: run node tests; extract inline script from gymapp.html and node --check it
environment_constraints: no PRs; commit locally on main; preserve UI language/i18n dict
contribution_requirements: Update BOTH gymapp.html and sw.js each change; bump CACHE in sw.js (forma-v39). sw.js SHELL lists index.html; inspect relation of gymapp.html vs index.html
key_patterns: Gym planner at gymapp.html gym(){...} ~line 732; translations around line 1108
